entities.text: Food Safety & Standards Case No. 7 of 2014-15
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: This order is appealable in terms of the act.
Mr. Manoj kumar, G.P. II submits that the tribunal now has already been constituted on 30.07.2020.
Considering his submission that the tribunal has already been constituted, I direct the petitioner to file the appeal before the concerned tribunal within six weeks.
If such appeal is filed the concerned tribunal will consider the same and will pass an order on the merits of the case.
With the aforesaid observation, this application is disposed of.
